content.short: The unique Cardano NFT collection of Charles Hoskinson, the founder and head of development at IOHK.
content.description:
I love ADA and I love its inventor, Charles Hoskinson, which is why I chose to create 10,000 HoskinToons NFTs on the Cardano Blockchain. With traits expertly illustrated to an insane level of detail, the HoskinToons have vowed to drop a collection of the highest quality with details to feast your eyes on.

All NFTs are unique in the fact that no two are identical. With 10's of millions possible configurations and a script which prevents doubles, uniqueness was the aim.

HoskinToons is an art project which will launch on January 15, 2022. When you choose to buy, a random number is reserved to ensure no one buys it out from under you, and you have time to make payment.
